section_summary.extract_value: This section describes Study 1, a cross-sectional online survey of 440 British men recruited via YMCA and other community media for the 'Men's Health and Well-Being Survey.' Participants completed demographic items and questionnaires online, with inclusion criteria requiring male gender and age 18 or older. The section notes that participants were also invited to complete follow-up surveys at 6 and 12 months as part of a separate longitudinal study.
